svg.aria-label: One merge strategy: Every change enters at develop. stage and main get only fast-forwards, behind an approved promotion, so dev, stg and prd run the same commit. The contract: branch-promotion.md holds the rules. promote-release runs a promotion. set-up-terraform-pipeline wires the CI/CD that enforces it. Tool guides: Picture-first guides for Brevo, Airtable and Aircall: the parts, before and after, how it flows, the traps, and links to the official docs. Start here: Open guides/tools/README.md
